title: 真实HTTPS审计账本：业务时间回拨、延迟转发与重复事件，保留来源/接收顺序且不伪算跨启动耗时
source: OpsForge 身份与安全补充编审
review_note: 现有ID改编；完成情况按精确题目、执行bundle及原生五路证据核对，不以脚本生成认定完成。
body:
## 操作任务
实现append_event(connection,record)和timeline(connection,trace)。events表为seq自增主键、host/boot/event_id/trace/digest/payload，并对(host,boot,event_id)唯一。record精确含host/boot/event_id/trace/wall_at/mono_ns/received_at/action；除mono_ns为非负非bool整数外，字段均非空字符串，两时间需带时区。保存原始来源字段与首次接收时间；同来源事件重传时忽略新received_at，对其余规范JSON的SHA256相同返回原seq，不同ValueError不覆盖。timeline按seq给received列表；仅同一host和boot时按mono_ns给source_order及首尾mono差elapsed_ns，否则source_order和elapsed_ns均None。真实子进程生成两条单调时间递增、业务墙钟字段回拨一小时的事件，缓冲后逆序经认证HTTPS转发到SQLite；另启两个真实子进程验证启动标识不同不能据此给跨启动精确耗时。不得用格式化墙钟代替单调间隔或把接收顺序当跨来源因果。

## 提交产物
task.py

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；实际隔离原生进程与明确边界。

## 能力边界
真实Python子进程、私有HTTPS采集器和持久SQLite账本。业务墙钟回拨由受控业务字段偏移注入，不修改系统时钟；进程启动标识由每个子进程生成，不能冒充主机重启、chrony/NTP修复、全网精准时钟同步或防篡改WORM审计。延期转发是受控缓冲逆序，不冒充TCP包级故障。测试服务凭据仅回环随机使用，不改默认身份/正式账号/信任或构建镜像，不新增原故障信用。
rubric: 同时保留带时区墙上时间、单调持续时间或事件序列、主机/进程启动标识及请求ID，记录时间同步异常
跨主机排序应考虑偏差范围，不能仅按格式化时间认定因果；检查日志转发延迟与重复，保留原始时间和接收时间

"""Private verified TLS fixtures; ephemeral CA files never enter host trust or default credentials."""
import contextlib,datetime,ipaddress,json,pathlib,ssl,threading,urllib.request,urllib.error
from http.server import ThreadingHTTPServer
from cryptography import x509
from cryptography.hazmat.primitives import hashes,serialization
from cryptography.hazmat.primitives.asymmetric import rsa
from cryptography.x509.oid import NameOID
def certificate(root):
 root=pathlib.Path(root);root.mkdir(exist_ok=True);now=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc);key=rsa.generate_private_key(public_exponent=65537,key_size=2048)
 name=x509.Name([x509.NameAttribute(NameOID.COMMON_NAME,'OpsForge ephemeral private TLS fixture')])
 cert=x509.CertificateBuilder().subject_name(name).issuer_name(name).public_key(key.public_key()).serial_number(x509.random_serial_number()).not_valid_before(now-datetime.timedelta(minutes=5)).not_valid_after(now+datetime.timedelta(hours=2)).add_extension(x509.BasicConstraints(ca=True,path_length=None),critical=True).add_extension(x509.SubjectAlternativeName([x509.IPAddress(ipaddress.ip_address('127.0.0.1'))]),critical=False).sign(key,hashes.SHA256())
 pem=root/'ca.pem';private=root/'key.pem';pem.write_bytes(cert.public_bytes(serialization.Encoding.PEM));private.write_bytes(key.private_bytes(serialization.Encoding.PEM,serialization.PrivateFormat.PKCS8,serialization.NoEncryption()))
 context=ssl.SSLContext(ssl.PROTOCOL_TLS_SERVER);context.load_cert_chain(str(pem),str(private));return pem,context
@contextlib.contextmanager
def server(root,handler):
 pem,context=certificate(root);http=ThreadingHTTPServer(('127.0.0.1',0),handler);http.daemon_threads=True;http.socket=context.wrap_socket(http.socket,server_side=True)
 thread=threading.Thread(target=http.serve_forever,daemon=True);thread.start()
 try:yield 'https://127.0.0.1:'+str(http.server_port),pem
 finally:http.shutdown();http.server_close();thread.join(timeout=3)
def client(cafile,jar=None):
 context=ssl.create_default_context(cafile=str(cafile));handlers=[urllib.request.ProxyHandler({}),urllib.request.HTTPSHandler(context=context)]
 if jar is not None:handlers.append(urllib.request.HTTPCookieProcessor(jar))
 opener=urllib.request.build_opener(*handlers)
 def call(method,url,payload=None,headers=None):
  req=urllib.request.Request(url,data=json.dumps(payload).encode() if payload is not None else (b'' if method=='POST' else None),method=method,headers={'Content-Type':'application/json',**(headers or {})})
  try:
   with opener.open(req,timeout=4) as r:status,raw,response_headers=r.status,r.read().decode(),dict(r.headers)
  except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:status,raw,response_headers=e.code,e.read().decode(),dict(e.headers)
  try:body=json.loads(raw)
  except ValueError:body=raw
  return status,body,response_headers
 return call

import datetime,json,pathlib,secrets,sys,time,os
sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path(__file__).parent))
from private_tls_http import client
config=json.loads(sys.stdin.read());call=client(config["ca"]);boot=str(os.getpid())+":"+secrets.token_hex(12);records=[]
for i in range(config["count"]):
 records.append(dict(host="private-training-host",boot=boot,event_id=secrets.token_hex(12),trace=config["trace"],wall_at=(datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc)-datetime.timedelta(hours=i)).isoformat(),mono_ns=time.monotonic_ns(),action="read" if i==0 else "write"));time.sleep(.02)
for record in reversed(records):
 assert call("POST",config["base"]+"/ingest",record,headers={"Authorization":"Bearer "+config["credential"]})[0]==200
print(json.dumps(records))

import contextlib,copy,datetime,json,pathlib,secrets,sqlite3,subprocess,sys,tempfile
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler
sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path.cwd()/"checks"))
import task
from private_tls_http import server,client
print("NATIVE_PLATFORM_READY",flush=True)
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="opsforge-audit-clock-") as temp:
 root=pathlib.Path(temp);db=root/"audit.sqlite";credential=secrets.token_urlsafe(32)
 with contextlib.closing(sqlite3.connect(db)) as c,c:c.execute("CREATE TABLE events(seq INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,host TEXT,boot TEXT,event_id TEXT,trace TEXT,digest TEXT,payload TEXT,UNIQUE(host,boot,event_id))")
 class Collector(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
  def log_message(self,*args):pass
  def do_POST(self):
   if self.headers.get("Authorization")!="Bearer "+credential:self.send_response(401);self.end_headers();return
   record=json.loads(self.rfile.read(int(self.headers["Content-Length"])));record["received_at"]=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
   try:
    with contextlib.closing(sqlite3.connect(db)) as c,c:seq=task.append_event(c,record)
    status,payload=200,{"seq":seq}
   except ValueError:status,payload=409,{}
   raw=json.dumps(payload).encode();self.send_response(status);self.send_header("Content-Length",str(len(raw)));self.end_headers();self.wfile.write(raw)
 with server(root/"tls",Collector) as (base,ca):
  call=client(ca)
  def worker(trace,count):
   p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"-I","-B","checks/audit_worker.py"],input=json.dumps(dict(base=base,ca=str(ca),credential=credential,trace=trace,count=count)),capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=10)
   assert p.returncode==0,p.stderr;return json.loads(p.stdout)
  print("STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED: actual authenticated child-process audit events through TLS into persistent ordered ledger",flush=True)
  records=worker("same-boot",2)
  assert records[1]["wall_at"]<records[0]["wall_at"] and records[1]["mono_ns"]>records[0]["mono_ns"]
  with contextlib.closing(sqlite3.connect(db)) as c,c:
   result=task.timeline(c,"same-boot");count=c.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM events").fetchone()[0]
  assert [r["event_id"] for r in result["received"]]==[records[1]["event_id"],records[0]["event_id"]]
  assert [r["event_id"] for r in result["source_order"]]==[records[0]["event_id"],records[1]["event_id"]]
  assert result["elapsed_ns"]==records[1]["mono_ns"]-records[0]["mono_ns"]>0
  assert all(r["received_at"]!=r["wall_at"] for r in result["received"])
  assert call("POST",base+"/ingest",records[0],headers={"Authorization":"Bearer "+credential})[0]==200
  changed=copy.deepcopy(records[0]);changed["action"]="tampered"
  assert call("POST",base+"/ingest",changed,headers={"Authorization":"Bearer "+credential})[0]==409
  with contextlib.closing(sqlite3.connect(db)) as c,c:assert c.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM events").fetchone()[0]==count and task.timeline(c,"same-boot")==result
  print("NATIVE_AUDIT_BUSINESS_WALL_ROLLBACK_BUFFERED_REORDER_MONOTONIC_SOURCE_ORDER_FIRST_RECEIPT_AND_DUPLICATE_IDENTITY_PRESERVED",flush=True)
  first=worker("cross-boot",1);second=worker("cross-boot",1);assert first[0]["boot"]!=second[0]["boot"]
  with contextlib.closing(sqlite3.connect(db)) as c,c:cross=task.timeline(c,"cross-boot")
  assert len(cross["received"])==2 and cross["source_order"] is None and cross["elapsed_ns"] is None
  print("NATIVE_AUDIT_TWO_REAL_CHILD_STARTUPS_NO_CROSS_BOOT_CAUSAL_OR_DURATION_CLAIM",flush=True)
print("NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED",flush=True)
